responsibility: Provides the public scalar FP16 ACLE intrinsic header for Arm. Under the appropriate target feature guards and temporary fpu=fp-armv8 option context, it defines float16_t and inline wrappers for half-precision arithmetic, conversions, rounding modes, fused multiply-add/subtract, min/max, and sqrt operations that map directly onto Arm backend builtins or native scalar FP16 expressions.
